sections.title: One-Click Measurement
sections.description: Learn how automated Peltier temperature control removes manual correction from every reading on the Mettler Toledo Excellence R4.
body: Refractive index and Brix readings shift with temperature, which normally means either measuring at a fixed reference temperature every time, or correcting each reading manually afterward. Both routes cost time, and both introduce a place for human error to creep in.

Excellence R4 holds the sample at a controlled temperature automatically, accurate to ±0.1°C, across its working range. Combined with the 7" touchscreen interface, a measurement becomes genuinely one click: place the sample, press measure, read the temperature-corrected result directly.
